S1.readable-html.name: Can tools read your product details without clicking?
S1.readable-html.description: Checks whether key product facts arrive with the initial page as readable text, without needing extra clicks or interactions.
S1.readable-html.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

S1.scope.name: Can tools identify the main product on the page?
S1.scope.description: Checks whether tools can separate the product being sold from recommendations, reviews, navigation, and other products.
S1.scope.improve: Clearly distinguish the audited product content from other page content.

S1.configuration.name: Do the displayed details match the selected product option?
S1.configuration.description: Checks whether the displayed information clearly belongs to the selected size, color, model, or other option.
S1.configuration.improve: Associate displayed product values with the correct selected option.

S1.supporting-access.name: Can shoppers open your product guides and policies?
S1.supporting-access.description: Checks whether referenced specifications, guides, and policies can be read on the page or through working links.
S1.supporting-access.improve: Provide readable sections or usable links to relevant specifications, guides and policies.

S2.product-markup.name: Does your page include properly formatted product data for search tools?
S2.product-markup.description: Checks whether the page includes product data in formats search and AI tools can read, including correctly formatted product JSON-LD.
S2.product-markup.group: Product data for search and AI
S2.product-markup.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

S2.product-identity.name: Does your search data identify the correct product and options?
S2.product-identity.description: Checks whether the product data identifies the right product, connects its options, and matches the product shown to shoppers.
S2.product-identity.group: Product data for search and AI
S2.product-identity.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

S2.offer-agreement.name: Do search tools receive the same price and availability shoppers see?
S2.offer-agreement.description: Checks whether the product data links to the correct product or option and matches its displayed price, currency, and availability.
S2.offer-agreement.group: Product data for search and AI
S2.offer-agreement.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

S2.identifiers.name: Are your product identification codes correct?
S2.identifiers.description: Checks whether applicable identifiers, such as a barcode, manufacturer part number, or SKU, are valid and belong to the right product or option.
S2.identifiers.group: Product data for search and AI
S2.identifiers.improve: Publish verified manufacturer or global product codes where applicable and link them to the correct product or option.

S2.optional-claims.name: Do extra claims in your search data match your page?
S2.optional-claims.description: Checks whether additional claims in the product data agree with what shoppers can see on the page.
S2.optional-claims.group: Product data for search and AI
S2.optional-claims.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

S4.page-labels.name: Do your page title and headings clearly label the product and its details?
S4.page-labels.description: Checks whether the title and main heading identify the product and whether section labels make its details easy to find.
S4.page-labels.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

S4.image-alternatives.name: Do your product images have useful text descriptions?
S4.image-alternatives.description: Checks whether informative product images include text descriptions that explain what they show.
S4.image-alternatives.improve: Give each informative product image an accurate text description. Verify which images need a change in the evidence below.

S5.crawler-access.name: Does your website allow access by search and AI tools?
S5.crawler-access.description: Checks whether the website’s crawler rules allow the search and AI tools included in this audit to access the product URL.
S5.crawler-access.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

S5.sitemap.name: Is your product page listed in a working sitemap?
S5.sitemap.description: Checks whether the website has a readable sitemap that lists this product page or its verified preferred URL.
S5.sitemap.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

S5.llms-txt.name: Does your website provide an information guide for AI tools?
S5.llms-txt.description: Checks whether the website provides an llms.txt file that explains the site and links to useful, working resources.
S5.llms-txt.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

C1.identity-explanation.name: Is it clear what your product is and what it does?
C1.identity-explanation.description: Checks whether the page identifies the product, includes its brand or model where relevant, and specifically explains what it does.
C1.identity-explanation.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

C1.options-selection.name: Can shoppers choose an option and see what’s included?
C1.options-selection.description: Checks whether shoppers can understand the selected option, what comes with their purchase, and how to choose the right option.
C1.options-selection.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

C1.essential-specs.name: Have you included the specifications shoppers need?
C1.essential-specs.description: Checks whether the page provides the specifications shoppers need for this type of product, including relevant measurements and units.
C1.essential-specs.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

C1.supporting-details.name: Have you explained product care and important precautions?
C1.supporting-details.description: Checks whether the page provides useful supporting details, care instructions, and relevant restrictions or precautions.
C1.supporting-details.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

C1.use-compatibility.name: Have you explained how to use the product and what it works with?
C1.use-compatibility.description: Checks whether the page explains what the product is suitable for and what it works with, where relevant.
C1.use-compatibility.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

C3.price-stock.name: Can shoppers see the price and whether their option is available?
C3.price-stock.description: Checks whether shoppers can understand the current price, currency, pricing conditions, and availability of their selected option.
C3.price-stock.improve: Review the findings and update the relevant product information where needed.

C3.shipping.name: Can shoppers understand shipping costs and delivery?
C3.shipping.description: Checks whether applicable shipping information explains delivery coverage, cost or how it is calculated, and delivery guidance.
C3.shipping.improve: Provide verified shipping costs, delivery information and the conditions that apply.

C3.returns.name: Can shoppers understand your return policy?
C3.returns.description: Checks whether shoppers can understand return eligibility, the return window, and important conditions, including any final-sale restrictions.
C3.returns.improve: Make the applicable return window, eligibility and conditions clear.

C5.consistency.name: Do your product details agree across the page?
C5.consistency.description: Checks whether comparable facts agree across the information shoppers see for the same product, option, and buying conditions.
C5.consistency.improve: Resolve the conflicting facts identified in the findings and verify the correct value.

C5.claim-support.name: Have you provided support for important product claims?
C5.claim-support.description: Checks whether important product claims have relevant supporting information or clear qualifications on the page or in linked sources.
C5.claim-support.improve: Support the cited claims with relevant evidence or explain the conditions and limits.
